location.label: Your location
location.description: Auto estimates your city from your public IP. For accurate overhead detection, choose a fixed location in the web interface. Restart after changes.

radius_nm.label: Nearby radius (NM)
radius_nm.description: 1 NM = 1.85 km. Crowded searches may shrink to protect device memory.

overhead_nm.label: Overhead radius (NM)
overhead_nm.description: Horizontal distance, not height. Auto location is approximate. Capped at the nearby radius.

alerts.label: Overhead LED alert
alerts.description: Amber LED pulse when new traffic enters the overhead radius. No sound. Suppressed in demo mode.

demo.label: Demo mode
demo.description: Fictional traffic labeled D. No internet requests or alerts.
